title: Ms. Fitch
summary: Miss Fitch is a member of the Organization and the cold and calculating assistant of Dr. Benway.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
Miss Fitch helped to take [[Dante Vale]] prisoner after he was tricked by Dr. Benway into recovering the [[Amulet]] of [[Cerberus]] for him. She helped to sedate him before bundling him out of a van and prepared to execute him on Benway's orders. However, Dante used [[Stoneglove]] to escape his bonds and Miss Fitch was knocked out by another prisoner, [[Rahmas]]. {{Source|Cerberus (comic)}}

Miss Fitch assisted Dr. Benway in luring the Huntik team into a trap in their base in Prague by posing as [[Irina Blazek]], one of the [[Huntik Foundation]]'s best spies. After, [[Lok]] and [[Sophie]] were sent back in time by [[Kronos]], Fitch was knocked out by a raypulse from [[Zhalia Moon]]. She was later arrested along with Dr. Benway and taken back to the [[Huntik Foundation]]. {{source|The Power of Kronos}}

full_text:
Miss Fitch is a member of the Organization and the cold and calculating assistant of Dr. Benway.

History

Miss Fitch helped to take Dante Vale prisoner after he was tricked by Dr. Benway into recovering the Amulet of Cerberus for him. She helped to sedate him before bundling him out of a van and prepared to execute him on Benway's orders. However, Dante used Stoneglove to escape his bonds and Miss Fitch was knocked out by another prisoner, Rahmas. [Cerberus (comic)]

Miss Fitch assisted Dr. Benway in luring the Huntik team into a trap in their base in Prague by posing as Irina Blazek, one of the Huntik Foundation's best spies. After, Lok and Sophie were sent back in time by Kronos, Fitch was knocked out by a raypulse from Zhalia Moon. She was later arrested along with Dr. Benway and taken back to the Huntik Foundation. [The Power of Kronos]

Personality

Miss Fitch is a cold and ruthless individual, who willingly carried out the cruel orders of Dr. Benway. However, she was shown to be nervous when about to execute Dante Vale, as Dante noticed her hand shaking, suggesting a lack of experience. [Cerberus (comic)]

Abilities

Miss Fitch was and also skilled in physical combat. She was able to hold her own against Zhalia Moon. [The Power of Kronos]

Spells Utilized

• Boltflare
• Raypulse

'''Miss Fitch''' is a member of [[the Organization]] and the cold and calculating assistant of [[Dr. Benway]]. 
== History==
Miss Fitch helped to take [[Dante Vale]] prisoner after he was tricked by Dr. Benway into recovering the [[Amulet]] of [[Cerberus]] for him. She helped to sedate him before bundling him out of a van and prepared to execute him on Benway's orders. However, Dante used [[Stoneglove]] to escape his bonds and Miss Fitch was knocked out by another prisoner, [[Rahmas]]. {{Source|Cerberus (comic)}}

Miss Fitch assisted Dr. Benway in luring the Huntik team into a trap in their base in Prague by posing as [[Irina Blazek]], one of the [[Huntik Foundation]]'s best spies. After, [[Lok]] and [[Sophie]] were sent back in time by [[Kronos]], Fitch was knocked out by a raypulse from [[Zhalia Moon]]. She was later arrested along with Dr. Benway and taken back to the [[Huntik Foundation]]. {{source|The Power of Kronos}}

== Personality ==
Miss Fitch is a cold and ruthless individual, who willingly carried out the cruel orders of [[Dr. Benway]]. However, she was shown to be nervous when about to execute [[Dante Vale]], as Dante noticed her hand shaking, suggesting a lack of experience. {{Source|Cerberus (comic)}} 

== Abilities ==
Miss Fitch was and also skilled in physical combat. She was able to hold her own against [[Zhalia Moon]]. {{source|The Power of Kronos}}
